column1: # Go module licence overrides, read by check.sh and generate-third-party.sh.
#   module    Go module path. check.sh passes it to go-licenses as an --ignore
#             prefix, so the module's own packages leave the go-licenses check
#             and a guard in lib.sh checks them instead. Packages the module
#   detected  the LicenseName go-licenses reports for the module. The report
#             override applies only while the detection still matches.
#   license   the SPDX expression Payverge receives the module under
#   reason    short form; README.md has the long one
# Each row needs a guard_<module> function in lib.sh (lic_run_guard maps
# module path to guard). check.sh fails on a row without a guard and on a row
# whose module is no longer in the dependency graph.

column4: Library code outside cmd/ is LGPL-3.0 (upstream README, COPYING.LESSER); go-licenses only sees the root GPL COPYING. Guard: no go-ethereum/cmd/ package is linked.
Dual FTL / GPL-2.0-or-later at the licensee's choice; Payverge elects the FreeType License. Credit in NOTICE. Guard: LICENSE still offers the choice and licenses/ftl.txt exists.
